basic_details.job_title: GMC Hingoli Visiting Faculty Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.short_information: Government Medical College, Hingoli will hold a walk-in interview for the post of Visiting Faculty on 17 November 2026 at 11.00 AM at the Dean's Office, Govt. Medical College, Hingoli. After that date, the interview will be held every Tuesday at 11.00 AM until all Visiting Faculty posts are filled. The posts are purely temporary, and the notice is signed by the Dean, Govt. Medical College, Hingoli.

important_dates.raw: First walk-in interview: 17 November 2026 at 11.00 AM. Further walk-in interviews: every Tuesday at 11.00 AM after 17 November 2026. The Tuesday interviews continue till all Visiting Faculty posts are filled. All interviews are held at the Dean's Office, Govt. Medical College, Hingoli.

faq.question: Q1. When is the GMC Hingoli Visiting Faculty walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The first walk-in interview is on 17 November 2026 at 11.00 AM, and it will then be held every Tuesday at 11.00 AM till all Visiting Faculty posts are filled.

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The interview is held at 11.00 AM on 17 November 2026 and at 11.00 AM on every following Tuesday.

faq.question: Q3. Where is the GMC Hingoli walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The venue is the Dean's Office, Govt. Medical College, Hingoli.

faq.question: Q4. Are the GMC Hingoli Visiting Faculty posts permanent?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that these posts are purely temporary.

faq.question: Q5. Where is the detailed GMC Hingoli Visiting Faculty advertisement?
faq.answer: The detail advertisement is published on the notice board of Government Medical College, Hingoli and on the website gmchingoli.in.

faq.question: Q6. Can I attend on a date after 17 November 2026?
faq.answer: Yes, the walk-in interview will be held every Tuesday at 11.00 AM after 17 November 2026, but only till all Visiting Faculty posts are filled.
